attributes.description:
Controls the internal spacing inside page content areas (the main content sections of web pages). This creates breathing room around the page content.
CSS variable: --wm-page-content-padding

Sets the background color of page content areas (the main content sections of web pages). This is the main background color that appears behind the page content.
CSS variable: --wm-page-content-background

Sets the color of the border around page content areas. This determines the color of the line that outlines the page content section.
CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-color

Controls the thickness of the border around page content areas. When set to 0, there is no visible border.
CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-width

Controls the style of the border around page content areas. 'none' removes the border, 'solid' creates a continuous line, 'dashed' creates a broken line, 'dotted' creates small dots.
CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-style

Controls the corner rounding of page content areas. When set to 'none', the page content has sharp corners. Higher values create more rounded corners for a softer appearance.
CSS variable: --wm-page-content-border-radius

Controls the drop shadow effect around page content areas. This creates a subtle shadow that makes the page content appear to float above the background, giving it depth and elevation.
CSS variable: --wm-page-content-shadow
